entities.name: Jurassic World Collection
entities.description: A Universes Beyond booster insert set of 26 cards based on the Jurassic World franchise, released with The Lost Caverns of Ixalan.

entities.name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan
entities.description: The set (and plane) in whose boosters the Jurassic World Collection cards were distributed; both feature dinosaurs.

entities.name: Michael Crichton
entities.description: The creator of the Jurassic franchise, whose 1990 novel Jurassic Park first featured it.

entities.name: Ravenous Tyrannosaurus
entities.description: A card in the set that was misprinted with extra words in its devour reminder text.

events.summary: The Jurassic World Collection is released as a booster insert alongside The Lost Caverns of Ixalan.
events.quote: The Jurassic World Collection is a booster insert set in the Magic: The Gathering Universes Beyond series

events.summary: In the franchise storyline, dinosaurs are created by genetic engineering from ancient DNA preserved in amber.
events.quote: The dinosaurs are created through genetic engineering

events.summary: Ravenous Tyrannosaurus is misprinted with extra words in its devour reminder text.
events.quote: Ravenous Tyrannosaurus erroneously features some extra words in the devour reminder text

relations.note: Crichton created the franchise the set is based on.
relations.quote: The franchise was created by Michael Crichton
